| [1.0.1](https://svgslid.es/docs/release-notes/1-0.md) | July 2026 | Removed an unused permission |  |  | One host permission |
| [1.0.0](https://svgslid.es/docs/release-notes/1-0.md) | July 2026 | First release: drag SVG files onto a slide |  |  |  |

Version 1.1.0 was an internal build and was not released. Its changes shipped in 1.2.0.

# Version 1.4.0: technical changelog

Applies to: SVG to Slides Chrome extension, version 1.4.0.

Version 1.4.0 gives the toolbar its own colour panel, with opacity, an eyedropper and a gradient builder. It replaces a colour across a slide or the whole presentation, shows changes on the slide while you pick, keeps the shape when it masks an image, and brings SVG gradients and transparency across on import. It asks for no new permission.

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Version | 1.4.0 |
| Date | November 24, 2026 |
| Download size | 434 KB (1.3.1: 399 KB) |
| Installed size | 1.3 MB (1.3.1: 1.1 MB) |
| Chrome permissions | storage (unchanged) |

## Colour

| Mark | Change | Topic |
|---|---|---|
| NEW | Colour panel for fill and stroke: colour square, hue and opacity bars, eyedropper, hex field, the slide's colours and recent colours. | [Colour, gradients and stroke](https://svgslid.es/docs/fill-stroke.md#panel) |
| CHG | **Fill colour** and **Stroke colour** open the colour panel. In 1.3.0 they opened Slides' own menus. | [Colour, gradients and stroke](https://svgslid.es/docs/fill-stroke.md#panel) |
| NEW | Gradient builder: linear and radial, stops on a bar, an angle dial, a start point for radial gradients. | [Colour, gradients and stroke](https://svgslid.es/docs/fill-stroke.md#gradients) |
| NEW | Text colour. With text highlighted, the panel colours those words only. | [Colour, gradients and stroke](https://svgslid.es/docs/fill-stroke.md#text) |
| NEW | Replace a colour. With nothing selected, one colour is changed wherever it is used: fills, strokes, gradient stops and text, inside groups too. **All slides** runs it across the presentation. | [Colour, gradients and stroke](https://svgslid.es/docs/fill-stroke.md#replace) |
| NEW | Live preview. The slide shows the colour, opacity, gradient, text colour or stroke weight while the panel or the field is in use. | [Colour, gradients and stroke](https://svgslid.es/docs/fill-stroke.md#preview) |
| CHG | **Fill colour** is available with nothing selected. | [Colour, gradients and stroke](https://svgslid.es/docs/fill-stroke.md#replace) |
| NEW | A colour change is made on the object itself, through Slides' own colour dialog or paint format, so the object keeps its animation and link. | [Colour, gradients and stroke](https://svgslid.es/docs/fill-stroke.md#applied) |
| NEW | A change that takes longer than about a fifth of a second shows a labelled progress bar. | [Undo and redo](https://svgslid.es/docs/undo-redo.md) |

## Image masks

| Mark | Change | Topic |
|---|---|---|
| CHG | **Mask image with shape** keeps the shape. It stays on top of the masked picture with no fill, and the two are grouped. | [Masking an image](https://svgslid.es/docs/mask-image.md#result) |
| NEW | The picture can be moved and resized under its mask: double-click the group, or press Option+Shift+K again. | [Masking an image](https://svgslid.es/docs/mask-image.md#adjust) |
| NEW | A stroke applied to a mask group goes to the shape only. A fill on the whole group is refused. | [Masking an image](https://svgslid.es/docs/mask-image.md#colour) |

## Inserting SVG files

| Mark | Change | Topic |
|---|---|---|
| NEW | Linear and radial gradients arrive as Slides gradients. The stops are re-timed onto the line Slides draws. | [Inserting SVG files](https://svgslid.es/docs/insert-svg.md#converts) |
| NEW | `opacity`, `fill-opacity` and `stroke-opacity` are kept. | [Inserting SVG files](https://svgslid.es/docs/insert-svg.md#converts) |
| FIX | A gradient no longer arrives as its first colour. | [FIX: A gradient arrives as one solid colour](https://svgslid.es/docs/kb/gradient-becomes-solid-colour.md) |

## Edit Shape and text

| Mark | Change | Topic |
|---|---|---|
| FIX | Edit Shape draws a shape's gradient and opacity while you edit. In 1.3.0 a gradient shape was drawn flat. | [Edit Shape: points and curves](https://svgslid.es/docs/edit-shape.md) |
| CHG | The tick and the cross on the Edit Shape pill keep or cancel everything changed since the pill came up. Neither leaves the editor. | [Edit Shape: points and curves](https://svgslid.es/docs/edit-shape.md#exact-values) |
| FIX | **Outline text** on text set bold with the B button, in a font with no bold face, is drawn as Chrome draws it. | [Outlining strokes and text](https://svgslid.es/docs/outline-stroke-text.md) |
| FIX | Text boxes that come from a layout can be grouped with shapes. They become plain text boxes first. | [The Layers panel](https://svgslid.es/docs/layers.md) |
| CHG | A name given in Layers follows a copy of the object to another slide or presentation on the same computer. | [The Layers panel](https://svgslid.es/docs/layers.md#stored) |

## Undo

| Mark | Change | Topic |
|---|---|---|
| NEW | Colour changes, Replace a colour across all slides, and moving the picture under a mask each undo with one press. | [Undo and redo](https://svgslid.es/docs/undo-redo.md#which) |
| FIX | One-press undo no longer stops short after a change to opacity, text colour, a gradient, or a picture's position under its mask. | [Undo and redo](https://svgslid.es/docs/undo-redo.md) |

## Limits in this version

| Limit | Detail |
|---|---|
| Gradient on an object whose text has several styles | The object is replaced, so its animation and link are not kept. |
| Stroke weights that are not Slides' own | The object is replaced. |
| Fill on a whole mask group | Refused. Fill the shape inside the group. |
| Rotated images | Still cannot be masked. |
| Deck colours | Read from the filmstrip. Slides far down a long filmstrip may not be listed until scrolled to. |
| A narrow window | If Slides folds its fill or border button under the More menu, the colour panel cannot apply a colour and says so. Use Slides' own menu, or widen the window. |
| Workspace Add-on and Web Uploader | Unchanged by this release. |

The illustrated post, with a clip of each feature, is on the [What's new](https://svgslid.es/whats-new#v14) page.

# Version 1.3.0: technical changelog

Applies to: SVG to Slides Chrome extension, version 1.3.0.

Version 1.3.0 puts a pen, image masks, shape combining, instant align and a Layers panel on the slide, with one toolbar for all of it. The converter now runs as JavaScript inside the extension, which makes the package 92% smaller and removes the server fallback and its permission.

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Version | 1.3.0 |
| Date | November 2026 |
| Download size | 392 KB (1.2.0: 5.8 MB) |
| Installed size | 1.1 MB (1.2.0: 14 MB) |
| Chrome permissions | storage |

## Toolbar and commands

| Mark | Change | Topic |
|---|---|---|
| NEW | One toolbar at the left edge of the slide canvas, two columns wide. Closed, it is a single round button. Option+\ opens and closes it. The state is remembered. | [The toolbar](https://svgslid.es/docs/toolbar.md) |
| NEW | Command palette, Command+\: every command by name, with its shortcut. | [The command palette](https://svgslid.es/docs/command-palette.md) |
| NEW | Tooltips with shortcuts on every button, pop-out item and field. | [The toolbar](https://svgslid.es/docs/toolbar.md#tooltips) |
| NEW | Stroke weight field in pixels, stroke on and off, thinner and thicker stroke. | [Colour, gradients and stroke](https://svgslid.es/docs/fill-stroke.md) |
| NEW | On a short canvas the Combine and Outline groups fold into one pop-out button each. | [The toolbar](https://svgslid.es/docs/toolbar.md#short) |

## Drawing and editing

| Mark | Change | Topic |
|---|---|---|
| NEW | Pen. Draws new shapes anywhere on the slide, point by point. Option+Shift+P. | [Drawing with the pen](https://svgslid.es/docs/pen.md) |
| NEW | Snapping to points, their lines, the slide's edges and centre, whole pixels, or a grid of any size. | [Snapping](https://svgslid.es/docs/snapping.md) |
| NEW | A box around the selection in Edit Shape scales, stretches, skews and rotates. | [Edit Shape: points and curves](https://svgslid.es/docs/edit-shape.md#smart-box) |
| NEW | Exact values: width, height, rotation and corner radius can be typed. Option-drag changes any number. | [Edit Shape: points and curves](https://svgslid.es/docs/edit-shape.md#exact-values) |
| CHG | The Edit Shape toolbar has two columns and repeats the main toolbar's command groups. Commands used inside the editor are applied on **Done**. | [Edit Shape: points and curves](https://svgslid.es/docs/edit-shape.md#scope) |
| CHG | A whole Edit Shape or pen session is one undo step on the slide. | [Undo and redo](https://svgslid.es/docs/undo-redo.md) |
| NEW | SVG markup copied as text can be pasted onto the slide and placed with a click. | [Inserting SVG files](https://svgslid.es/docs/insert-svg.md#paste-code) |

## Shape operations

| Mark | Change | Topic |
|---|---|---|
| NEW | Union, Subtract, Intersect, Exclude, on the slide and inside Edit Shape. | [Combining shapes](https://svgslid.es/docs/combine-shapes.md) |
| NEW | Mask image with shape, Option+Shift+K. Any shape or group cuts the picture under it, and the picture keeps its position and size. The result is the same kind of object Slides makes when an image is cropped to a shape. | [Masking an image](https://svgslid.es/docs/mask-image.md) |
| NEW | Outline stroke and Outline text. Outlined text can be restored on the computer that outlined it. | [Outlining strokes and text](https://svgslid.es/docs/outline-stroke-text.md) |
| NEW | Stroke position: inside, centre, outside. | [Outlining strokes and text](https://svgslid.es/docs/outline-stroke-text.md#position) |
| NEW | Align and distribute commands with shortcuts. They run Slides' own Align, Distribute and Center on page behind a still copy of the slide, so objects move once and images stay intact. | [Aligning and distributing](https://svgslid.es/docs/align-distribute.md) |
| NEW | One object, an image included, aligns to the slide's edges. A 1 pixel helper is placed, used and removed in one undo step. | [Aligning and distributing](https://svgslid.es/docs/align-distribute.md#single) |
| NEW | One-press undo and redo for the extension's multi-step changes. | [Undo and redo](https://svgslid.es/docs/undo-redo.md) |

## Layers and selection

| Mark | Change | Topic |
|---|---|---|
| NEW | Layers panel, Option+1: select, add to the selection, restack, rename, hide, fold groups. | [The Layers panel](https://svgslid.es/docs/layers.md) |
| NEW | Theme objects are greyed and marked M. A second click opens the theme builder on the layout or master that holds the object. Option+Shift+M opens the theme builder and returns. | [Theme objects](https://svgslid.es/docs/theme-objects.md) |
| NEW | Command-click selects the innermost object inside groups. | [The Layers panel](https://svgslid.es/docs/layers.md#direct-select) |
| NEW | Objects under 6 pixels on screen get a zoom-in on the second click. | [The Layers panel](https://svgslid.es/docs/layers.md#small) |

## Converter

| Mark | Change | Topic |
|---|---|---|
| CHG | The converter is JavaScript inside the extension. It replaces the Python converter that ran in WebAssembly. Output was compared on all 138 SVG files in the project's repository and was identical, byte for byte. | [How conversion works](https://svgslid.es/docs/how-conversion-works.md#javascript) |
| CHG | Every shape's points are written at full precision and scaled by the shape's transform, so a graphic inserted small keeps its detail when enlarged. | [Point precision](https://svgslid.es/docs/point-precision.md) |

## Packaging and permissions

| Mark | Change |
|---|---|
| CHG | The download is 392 KB, down from 5.8 MB. Installed, the extension is 1.1 MB, down from 14 MB: 92% smaller. |
| REM | The bundled Python runtime and the converter's Python files. |
| REM | The converter fallback on the svgslid.es server, and the host permission that reached it. SVG files are never uploaded. |
| REM | The content security policy entry that allowed WebAssembly to run. |
| CHG | Chrome permissions: storage only. Storage now also holds the toolbar state, snapping settings, layer names, and the memory that restores outlined text and stroke position. See [Permissions and data](https://svgslid.es/docs/permissions-privacy.md#storage). |
| NEW | Bundled open-source libraries, all under the MIT licence: Paper.js 0.12.18 and paperjs-offset 2.2.2 for shape geometry, fontkit 3.0.0 for reading font outlines. |

## Fixes

| Mark | Change |
|---|---|
| FIX | Layer tooltips no longer read "undefined". |
| FIX | Renaming a layer always ends with Enter, Esc or a click elsewhere. |
| FIX | Objects are no longer flagged as theme objects, or as too small to see, by mistake. |

## Known limits

- Gradients, pattern fills, transparency and shadows are not carried through Combine and Outline. Images, video and charts cannot be combined or outlined.
- Rotated images cannot be masked yet. Text must be outlined before it is used as a mask.
- Layer names, the memory that restores outlined text, and stroke position memory are kept on the computer you used.
- Skew is available in Edit Shape only. Only top-level layers can be dragged to restack.
- One-press undo is lost if you change the slide after the extension's change.
- The pen has no freehand mode.

The full list is in [Limits and known issues](https://svgslid.es/docs/limits.md).

## Upgrading from 1.2.0

Chrome installs 1.3.0 on its own. Version 1.3.0 holds fewer permissions than 1.2.0, so Chrome does not ask you to approve anything. The first time you open Slides after the update, a note names the changes. The toolbar starts closed: look for the round button at the left edge of the slide canvas.

- [Limits and known issues](https://svgslid.es/docs/limits.md)

# Version 1.2.0: technical changelog

Applies to: SVG to Slides Chrome extension, version 1.2.0.

Version 1.2.0 adds Edit Shape, a vector editor that opens on the slide, and corner rounding. It works on Slides' own shapes as well as inserted ones. Inserting no longer needs a paste: the click places the shapes.

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Version | 1.2.0 |
| Date | November 2026 |
| Download size | 5.8 MB |
| Installed size | 14 MB |
| Chrome permissions | storage, and one host permission for the converter fallback |

## Editor

| Mark | Change | Topic |
|---|---|---|
| NEW | Edit Shape. Double-click a shape and click **Edit Shape**. An editor opens on the slide at the shape's exact size and position: drag points and curve handles, add and remove points, select several, undo, redo, zoom and pan. **Done** updates the shape in place. | [Edit Shape: points and curves](https://svgslid.es/docs/edit-shape.md) |
| NEW | Round corners. Drag a circle inside a corner or type a radius in pixels. A whole shape or several shapes round together. | [Rounding corners](https://svgslid.es/docs/round-corners.md) |
| NEW | Edit Shape opens on Slides' own shapes, lines, text boxes and WordArt by converting them to custom shapes first. The conversion reads the outlines Slides itself draws. **Cancel** restores the original. | [Editing Slides' own shapes](https://svgslid.es/docs/convert-slides-shapes.md) |
| NEW | Shapes stacked above the one being edited stay visible, and **Done** returns each edited shape to its place in the stack. | [Edit Shape: points and curves](https://svgslid.es/docs/edit-shape.md#done) |

## Inserting

| Mark | Change | Topic |
|---|---|---|
| CHG | Click to insert. Drop an SVG and click where it goes. The shapes land with nothing to paste. If Slides does not accept them, the extension asks for Command+V. | [Inserting SVG files](https://svgslid.es/docs/insert-svg.md) |
| CHG | Placement is measured from the slide. Earlier versions estimated it from the window size. | [FIX: Inserted shapes landed away from the pointer in versions 1.0.0 and 1.0.1](https://svgslid.es/docs/kb/shapes-land-away-from-pointer.md) |

## Converter

| Mark | Change | Topic |
|---|---|---|
| CHG | Shapes with one outline, straight segments only and no more than 150 points land as Slides polylines, so Slides' own Edit points works on them. | [Edit points and polylines](https://svgslid.es/docs/edit-points-and-polylines.md) |
| FIX | For those shapes, a closing segment that repeated the start point is dropped. It left two points in one place, and dragging one tore the corner. |  |

## Fixes

| Mark | Change |
|---|---|
| FIX | Placement and the editor measure the slide you have open. Before, visiting another slide first could throw both off. |
| FIX | The editor measures the visible canvas, so editing while Slides is zoomed in works. |
| FIX | Shapes picked from inside a group are placed correctly when edited. |

## Permissions and updates

| Mark | Change |
|---|---|
| NEW | The storage permission, used to remember that the update note has been shown. |
| NEW | A one-time note in the corner of Slides after the update, naming the changes. New installations do not see it. |

## Notes

Version 1.1.0 was an internal build of the editor and was not released. Everything in it shipped in 1.2.0.

Version 1.3.0 changes parts of what is described here: the editor's toolbar, the permissions and the converter. See [Version 1.3.0](https://svgslid.es/docs/release-notes/1-3-0.md).

# Versions 1.0.0 and 1.0.1: technical changelog

Applies to: SVG to Slides Chrome extension, versions 1.0.0 and 1.0.1.

Version 1.0.0 is the first release: drag SVG files onto a Google Slides tab and they land as native, editable shapes, converted inside the browser. Version 1.0.1 removed an unused permission.

## Version 1.0.1

July 2026.

| Mark | Change |
|---|---|
| REM | The activeTab permission. The extension did not use it, and Chrome Web Store review flagged it. |

## Version 1.0.0

July 2026. First release.

| Mark | Change |
|---|---|
| NEW | Drag one or more .svg files onto an open Google Slides tab. A preview follows the pointer. |
| NEW | Place the graphic, then press Command+V to confirm. The shapes land as native Slides shapes, one per path, grouped per file. |
| NEW | Up to 25 files per drop, laid out in a grid on the current slide. |
| NEW | Conversion runs inside the browser. The converter was the project's Python converter, compiled to WebAssembly. A converter on the svgslid.es server was the fallback. |
| NEW | No Google sign-in and no Google permissions. |

## How 1.0 differs from later versions

| In 1.0 | Since |
|---|---|
| Every insert ended with Command+V. | 1.2.0: the click places the shapes. |
| Position was estimated from the window size. See [FIX: Inserted shapes landed away from the pointer in versions 1.0.0 and 1.0.1](https://svgslid.es/docs/kb/shapes-land-away-from-pointer.md). | 1.2.0: measured from the slide. |
| No editing tools. | 1.2.0: [Edit Shape: points and curves](https://svgslid.es/docs/edit-shape.md). 1.3.0: [The toolbar](https://svgslid.es/docs/toolbar.md). |
| The extension carried a Python runtime. | 1.3.0: a JavaScript converter. See [How conversion works](https://svgslid.es/docs/how-conversion-works.md#javascript). |

## See also

- [Version history](https://svgslid.es/docs/release-notes.md)
- [Version 1.2.0](https://svgslid.es/docs/release-notes/1-2-0.md)
- [Inserting SVG files](https://svgslid.es/docs/insert-svg.md)
- [How shapes reach the slide](https://svgslid.es/docs/how-shapes-reach-the-slide.md)

Source: https://svgslid.es/docs/release-notes/1-0 (SVG to Slides Documentation, Release Notes). Last reviewed November 20, 2026.
